datasets.name: COMPARISON_NORGESPRIS
datasets.description: Provides grid owners the estimated Norgespris cost for the metering points they have contracts with, similar to what end users see in MinSide.

columns.name: costNorwayPrice
columns.description: The cost using Norway price in NOK. quantityKwh*norwayPrice. VAT is included except for metering Points located in Troms, Finnmark and Nordland.

columns.name: costSpotPrice
columns.description: The cost using Spot price in NOK. quantityKwh*spotPrice. VAT is included except for metering Points located in Troms, Finnmark and Nordland.

columns.name: costSupportPrice
columns.description: The cost of the Support price in NOK. quantityKwh*supportPrice. VAT is included except for metering Points located in Troms, Finnmark and Nordland.

columns.name: endTime
columns.description: The end time of the interval.

columns.name: hasExceededMonthlyNorwayThreshold
columns.description: If the interval has crossed the monthly threshold for Norway price. The first interval that crosses the threshold will have FALSE, the following will have TRUE.

columns.name: hasExceededMonthlySupportThreshold
columns.description: If the interval has crossed the monthly threshold for Support price. The first interval that crosses the threshold will have FALSE, the following will have TRUE.

columns.name: norwayPrice
columns.description: Norway price in NOK/kWh. VAT is included except for metering Points located in Troms, Finnmark and Nordland. After monthly treshold is crossed, Norway price = Spot Price.

columns.name: quantityKwh
columns.description: The quantity in kWh for the metering value.

columns.name: spotPrice
columns.description: Spot price in NOK/kWh. VAT is included except for metering Points located in Troms, Finnmark and Nordland.

columns.name: startTime
columns.description: The start time of the interval.

columns.name: supportPrice
columns.description: Support price in NOK/kWh. VAT is included except for metering Points located in Troms, Finnmark and Nordland. After monthly treshold is crossed OR price is lower than the support price upper bound, Support price = Spot Price.
